privacy.draft: Draft — have this reviewed by a licensed attorney before publishing.
privacy.collectText: When you submit a consultation request we collect your name, email address, an optional message, and your topic of interest (if provided). We also store a one-way hash of your IP address solely for spam prevention and rate limiting; the raw IP address is never stored.
privacy.useText1: We use your name, email, message, and topic of interest to follow up on your consultation request and to share that information with The Longevity Consultants so they can contact you to schedule a free consultation.
privacy.useText2: We do not sell your personal information. We do not use it for marketing unrelated to your request. We do not use analytics or tracking cookies.
privacy.retentionText: We keep consultation requests for up to 12 months from the date of submission, after which they are automatically deleted.
privacy.rightsText: You may request deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us through the consultation form and noting your request. We will delete your record promptly.
privacy.securityText: Your data is stored in a secured database. We take reasonable technical precautions to protect it from unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss.
privacy.contactText: For questions about this privacy policy or to request deletion of your data, please use the consultation form and indicate your request in the message field.
